title: Strixhaven: School of Mages: card flavor text

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school of mages on Arcavios, with five colleges, whose heart was left undefended when mage hunters attacked.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The world dotted with ancient ruins, many guarded by Blood Age soldiers long dead.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: Dark mage and alumnus of Strixhaven who took control of the Oriq to take vengeance on his alma mater.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Sinister mages who thirst for forbidden secrets of the past and use mage hunters; Extus took control of them.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Vile monstrosities created by the Oriq to seek out and snuff out the arcane.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: One of the twins, who sought power and fit in at Prismari College.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: One of the twins, who sought arcane study; his quick thinking helped bring down the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Encouraged the twins to apply to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Professor Onyx
entities.description: Professor who urged the twins to prepare for Extus, sounding familiar with the rise of tyrants.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A creature brought down by Will and Rowan.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: Era of war on Arcavios whose magic Strixhaven forbade and whose soldiers still guard ruins.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Dragons who brought the Blood Age to an end.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Ancient beings with boundless knowledge, who speak in cryptic metaphors.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: The Oracle, found by wandering.

entities.name: Zimone

entities.name: Killian

events.summary: Kasmina encourages the twins to apply to Strixhaven.
events.quote: Kasmina had encouraged the twins to apply.

events.summary: The twins receive a letter inviting them to Strixhaven; Will sees study, Rowan sees power.
events.quote: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven.

events.summary: Rowan and Will find a natural fit in Prismari College.
events.quote: Rowan and Will were a natural fit in Prismari College, the school of outrageous elemental arts.

events.summary: Extus takes control of the Oriq with a lethal strike, his first step toward vengeance.
events.quote: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step towards vengeance.

events.summary: Extus begins his research into forbidden Blood Age magic.
events.quote: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

events.summary: The Oriq's infiltrators recruit mage-students for Extus's vengeance.
events.quote: His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

events.summary: The Oriq take notice of Zimone's brilliance.
events.quote: Zimone's brilliance drew attention from many, including the sinister mages known as the Oriq.

events.summary: Professor Onyx urges the twins to prepare for Extus.
events.quote: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus

events.summary: The twins each research spells to defeat Extus.
events.quote: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way.

events.summary: Extus stands before his alma mater and commands the mage hunters to unfold.
events.quote: At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.

events.summary: Mage hunters push in and professors scramble, leaving Strixhaven's heart undefended.
events.quote: Professors scrambled to push the mage hunters back, leaving the heart of Strixhaven undefended.

events.summary: Rowan draws on the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl while Will gasps.
events.quote: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl.

events.summary: Will's quick thinking and Rowan's power bring down the Blood Avatar.
events.quote: Will's quick thinking meshed with Rowan's raw power to bring down the Blood Avatar.

events.summary: Dina gives Killian a drink and he knows compassion for the first time.
events.quote: Dina raised her cup to Killian's lips, and for the first time in his life, he knew compassion.

events.summary: Quintorius, unsuited to a military academy, is expelled from its ranks.
events.quote: He agreed with the military academy on only one thing: he did not belong in their ranks.

events.summary: Rootha's art succeeds and she passes her course.
events.quote: Rootha passed with flying, living colors.

events.summary: Unsupervised portal use on campus is banned after mishaps.
events.quote: unsupervised portal use on campus was banned.
